measures.item: LED disk, the two mounting holes near its centre
measures.what: hole diameter, and centre-to-centre distance between the two holes; also say whether the line joining them is along the wire/connector direction (+y) or across it
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: outer diameter, board thickness, and height of the connector/wires sticking out of its back face, plus where the connector sits (distance from centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: board length and width, the four corner holes' centre-to-centre spacing along length and width, hole diameter, and total height from the board's underside to the top of the tallest part (ESP32/terminals)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board

measures.what: distance from the USB-C port mouth to the perfboard's nearest edge (how far the ESP32 overhangs or is set in), port centre height above the perfboard top face, and port mouth width and height
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: width and thickness of the plug body (the part that goes toward the ESP32 port) and how far the plug body sticks out from the port, and which direction its prongs go
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: screws you'll hang the box on (wall screws)
measures.what: head diameter, shank diameter, and head height
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.what: try again with a ruler laid across the whole board: overall diameter (a rough reading to the nearest mm is fine)
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.item: 4-pin connector on the LED disk's back
measures.what: width, length, height above the back face, and distance of its centre from the board centre
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: overall width, height and depth of the charger body, and the length of the USB-C plug that sticks out of the charger's face (plug shell length)
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.item: ESP32 USB-C port on the perfboard
measures.what: how far the front of the USB-C port (the mouth) sticks out beyond the ESP32 board's edge (or is set back from it), and how far the mouth is from the perfboard's end edge
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: thickness of the bare board (laminate only)
measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.item: perfboard with ESP32, viewed from the top with the USB-C port end towards you
measures.what: distance from the centre of the USB-C port to the perfboard's LEFT long edge, and to the RIGHT long edge
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: tallest soldered part on the perfboard other than the ESP32 (screw terminals or capacitor)
measures.what: height above the perfboard's top face, and whether anything sticks out beyond the board's edges
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: head height (thickness of the dome), and the thread major diameter
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.item: plug of the USB-C cable that goes into the ESP32
measures.what: width, thickness and length of the plug's moulded body (the part you hold), before the cable begins
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge
